Cast out for his ambitions, Skitskurr was now free from his obligations, free to weave a new reality of his own. Opening a gap in spacetime, the Weaver invites '[[Weaver#The Swarm|The Swarm]]' — young [[Beetle|Weavers]] to latch onto enemies, and nibble away at their armor. Nearly impossible to pin down, he slips into micro-wormholes, passing through enemies and reappearing with [[Weaver#Shukuchi|Shukuchi]]. The fabric of time frays around Skitskurr, occasionally replaying, causing his [[Weaver#Geminate Attack|Geminate Attacks]] to be witnessed — and felt — more than once. Fate also wields the blade that cuts them short. | soundclip = vo_weaver_weav_rare_02.mp3 | voice = David Scully | lore = The fabric of creation needs constant care, lest it grow tattered; for when it unravels, whole worlds come undone. It is the work of the Weavers to keep the fabric tight, to repair worn spots in the mesh of reality. They also defend from the things that gnaw and lay their eggs in frayed regions, whose young can quickly devour an entire universe if the Weavers let their attention lapse. Skitskurr was a master Weaver, charged with keeping one small patch of creation tightly woven and unfaded. But the job was not enough to satisfy. It nagged him that the original work of creation all lay in the past; the Loom had done its work and travelled on. He wanted to create rather than merely maintain—to weave worlds of his own devising. He began making small changes to his domain, but the thrill of creation proved addictive, and his strokes became bolder, pulling against the pattern that the Loom had woven.

The guardians came, with their scissors, and Weaver's world was pared off, snipped from the cosmic tapestry, which they rewove without him in it. Skitskurr found himself alone, apart from his kind, a state that would have been torment for any other Weaver. But Skitskurr rejoiced, for now he was free. Free to create for himself, to begin anew. The raw materials he needed to weave a new reality were all around him. All he had to do was tear apart this old world at the seams. }} ==Upgrades== ===Aghanim's=== {{Aghcard | aghname0 = Time Lapse (Ally) | aghdesc0 = new | aghname1 = Time Lapse | aghdesc1 = {{Show|A|Weaver|Time Lapse|desc1}} | shdname0 = Shukuchi | shddesc0 = {{Show|A|Weaver|Shukuchi|desc1}} | shdname1 = Geminate Attack | shddesc1 = {{Show|A|Weaver|Geminate Attack|desc1}} }} ===Talents=== {{Talents | hero = Weaver | t4l = +s:value {{A|Weaver|Geminate Attack}} Count | v4l = 1 | t4r = -s:values {{A|Weaver|Shukuchi}} Cooldown | v4r = 3 | t3l = +s:value {{A|Weaver|The Swarm}} Armor Reduction | v3l = 0.5 | t3r = +s:value {{A|Weaver|Geminate Attack}} Damage | v3r = 60 | t2l = +s:value {{A|Weaver|The Swarm|text=Beetles}} Hit Count | v2l = 1 | t2r = +s:value {{A|Weaver|Shukuchi}} Damage | v2r = 90 | t1l = +s:value% {{A|Weaver|Threads of Fate}} Damage | v1l = 5 | t1r = +s:value {{A|Weaver|Shukuchi}} Move Speed | v1r = 50 | notes = }} =={{Symbol|Innate|size=32px}} [[Innate]]== ===Threads of Fate=== {{Spellcard | id = 1754 | slot = inn;0;5 | intern = weaver_threads_of_fate | name = Threads of Fate | lore = | icon0 = Weaver Rewoven wikiasset | type0 = inn | target0 = Passive | affect0 = Enemy Heroes;Self | desc0 = Additionally applies a dormant debuff to enemy heroes whenever Weaver damages them.

To geminate is to double, coming from the Latin word for twin (as in Gemini). * {{A|Weaver|Shukuchi}} is a Japanese term for rapid movement, or teleportation. The ability's name is a reference to an [http://kenshin.wikia.com/wiki/Seta_S%C5%8Djir%C5%8D#Techniques ability of the same name] of a character named Soujiro from the anime Rurouni Kenshin.[https://www.reddit.com/r/DotA2/comments/2e1f3v/ama_with_neichus_guy_who_did_stuff/cjv790i Neichus, one of DotA's early developers and creator of Weaver, telling the origin of Shukuchi's ability name.] * Weaver draws many inspirations from a character of the same name in the novel, [[wikipedia:Perdido Street Station]]. * {{A|Weaver|Time Lapse}} icon may also be a reference to the [http://i.imgur.com/J6WwP6G.jpg box art] of the movie Alien 3, considering that [[wikipedia:Sigourney Weaver|Sigourney Weaver]] has the lead role in the film. * {{wc3}} similarities: ** Weaver uses the model of the {{wc3|Nerubian Queen}}, a big neutral creep. *** In DotA, Weaver's full title is Nerubian Weaver. It was shortened to just Weaver in Dota 2, removing any affiliation with the [https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Nerubian Nerubian], a race within the Warcraft universe. *** His name in DotA is Anub'Seran, a custom name inspired by the names of other Nerubians from the Warcraft universe. As such, it could not be used in Dota 2, since the "Anub" suffix appears to be something like a title or rank within the Nerubian race. ** {{A|Weaver|Geminate Attack}} is based on the {{wc3|Orb of Lightning}}, which originally has a chance to trigger a {{wc3|Purge}} on attack. The chance aspect was replaced with a cooldown, and the Purge aspect was replaced with {{wc3|Searing Arrows}}, with its damage set to 0. ** {{A|Weaver|Shukuchi}} is based on the {{wc3|Blademaster}}'s {{wc3|Blademaster|Wind Walk}}. ** Weaver's old ability, {{A|Weaver|Urna Swarm}}, was identical to the {{wc3|Crypt Lord}}'s {{wc3|Crypt Lord|Carrion Beetles}}. ** The {{U|Beetle|text=Beetles}} used the same model as Weaver's attack projectiles, which are a group of small bugs flying around. ==Gallery== Weaver Model.jpg|Model Weaver Concept Art1.jpg|[[Concept art]] Cosmetic icon Envisioning Weaver Loading Screen.png|[[Envisioning Weaver Loading Screen]] concept art Weaver ability icon progress.png|Ability icon progress Weaver hero icon progress.png|Hero icon progress The One True King Bone Harvest Weaver.png|[[Bone Harvest]] sprite - alive The One True King Bone Harvest Weaver dead.png|Bone Harvest sprite - dead Dota 2 Monster Hunter codex weaver gameasset.png|[[Dota 2 X Monster Hunter/Hero Atlas#Weaver|Monster Hunter Hero Atlas Illustration]] ==References== [[ru:Weaver]]
